# Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono

- Designer: Braille Institute of America, with Applied Design Works.
- Home page: https://www.brailleinstitute.org/freefont/
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`, unchanged from upstream). Copyright 2020-2024 The Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Project Authors. The licence allows bundling and embedding, so this family is textweaver's monospaced font; JetBrains Mono and Fira Mono were not needed.
- Version: 2.001 (from the fonts' `name` table).
- Source: the Google Fonts upstream repository, https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-mono, at commit `154d50362016cc3e873eb21d242cd0772384c8f9` (2024-11-20), folder `fonts/ttf`. The repository publishes no GitHub releases; this commit is the head of its `main` branch and the source Google Fonts builds from.
- Downloaded: 2026-09-25.
- Embedding: OS/2 `fsType` 0 (installable embedding allowed).
